NGS technologies are a major breakthrough for the development of genomic tools for tree breeding, allowing to elucidate genetic differences that give arise to observed phenotypically variation, to identify molecular markers for assisted breeding, to identify and characterize genes and gene families involved in the control of important traits, and to analyze the expression of genes in different genotypes and environmental condition.

the application of genomics tools in the breeding of fruit trees is increasing the genetic resources for selection, which will lead to the improvement of fruit quality and productivity.

the application of genomics tools to tree breeding programs, and the use of genomic resources in the identification of candidate genes related to important traits.
the use of genomic technologies to improve fruit trees.
the application of NGS techniques to the study of genes and gene regulation involved in fruit tree development.

the application of genomic technologies to the breeding of trees is a reality, and it will be a major driver of the tree improvement in the near future.

the application of NGS techniques in tree species will be a major revolution for plant breeding programs, providing new tools to identify genes and genomic intervals controlling important quantitative traits for selection, to elucidate the genetic basis of complex traits and to identify new molecular markers for assisted breeding.
the application of genomics technologies has opened a new era in the breeding of perennial fruit trees, which has been a challenge for many years, and will continue to be so in the future.

we have been able to identify genes and/or genomic regions controlling important traits for breeding in different fruit species, and we have also identified molecular markers for assisted breeding in these species.

genomic technologies are providing new tools for the identification of the genes and/or genetic markers controlling important traits for tree breeding programs, which are expected to be applied in a near future.
